comment:
* All logic for the {@link ConcatAdapter} is here so that we can clearly see a separation
 * between an adapter implementation and merging logic.

variables.name: mViewTypeStorage
variables.comment: * Holds the mapping from the view type to the adapter which reported that type.

variables.name: mAttachedRecyclerViews
variables.comment:
* We hold onto the list of attached recyclerviews so that we can dispatch attach/detach to
     * any adapter that was added later on.
     * Probably does not need to be a weak reference but playing safe here.

variables.name: mBinderLookup
variables.comment:
* Keeps the information about which ViewHolder is bound by which adapter.
     * It is set in onBind, reset at onRecycle.

variables.name: mReusableHolder
variables.comment: keep one of these around so that we can return wrapper & position w/o allocation ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

variables.name: mStableIdStorage
variables.comment: * This is where we keep stable ids, if supported
